items.title: 15.7 Effects of drugs on nervous coordination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of drugs and their effects (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Drug (dawa) khuraak ke ilawa woh madda hai jo kisi bimari ya ghair maamooli halat ki rok thaam, pehchan (diagnosis), ilaj ya alamaat mein kami ke liye istemal ho. Drugs dimagh ke kaam par bhi asar kar ke mizaj, hosh (awareness), khayalat, jazbat ya rawayye mein tabdeeli la sakti hain. Psychoactive drug woh drug hai jo dimagh ke kaam ko badal deti hai, jis se mizaj, samajh (perception), hosh (consciousness) aur rawayye mein tabdeeli aati hai. Psychoactive drugs ki misalein alcohol, caffeine, nicotine aur ghair qanooni (illicit) drugs jaise cocaine aur heroin waghaira hain. Narcotic drug (ya sirf narcotic) opioid qisam ki woh drug hai jo dard kam karne ke liye istemal hoti hai aur jis ki lat (addiction) aur ghalat istemal (abuse) ka bohat zyada imkan hai. Narcotics mein morphine, codeine aur oxycodone jaisi drugs shamil hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Tamam narcotics psychoactive drugs hain, lekin tamam psychoactive drugs narcotics nahin.

blocks.prompt: Kya caffeine narcotic hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Caffeine psychoactive hai (chaukasi badalti hai) magar opioid dard-kush dawa nahin, is liye narcotic nahin.

items: Drug: khuraak ke ilawa madda jo rok thaam, diagnosis, ilaj ya aaraam ke liye ho. Psychoactive drugs dimagh ka kaam badalti hain; narcotics opioid dard-kush drugs hain jin ki lat ka bara khatra hai.
